evals.prompt:
Our billing dashboard's transactions page looks like a 2014 admin template and I want it redesigned. Here's the component: ```tsx export function TransactionsPage() { const { data, isLoading, error } = useQuery(['transactions'], () => fetch('/api/transactions').then((r) => r.json()) ) if (isLoading) return
if (error) return
Something went wrong
if (!data.transactions.length) return

No transactions.

return (

Transactions

{data.transactions.map((t) => ( navigate(`/transactions/${t.id}`)}> ))}
DateDescriptionAmountStatus
{new Date(t.created_at).toLocaleDateString()} {t.description} ${(t.amount_cents / 100).toFixed(2)} {t.status}
) } ``` And this is what `GET /api/transactions` returns: ```json { "transactions": [ { "id": "txn_1a2b3c", "created_at": "2026-03-14T09:22:11Z", "description": "Acme Corp - invoice #4471", "amount_cents": 248000, "currency": "USD", "status": "succeeded", "counterparty": { "name": "Acme Corp", "id": "cus_9x8y" }, "payment_method": "card_visa_4242" } ], "has_more": true } ``` Can you put together a prompt I can paste into a design tool to get a proper modern version of this page?
evals.expected_output: An audit of the current page, fintech benchmarks (Stripe/Mercury/Ramp) each with a named mechanic, a self-contained paste-ready generation prompt whose content inventory covers every rendered field plus the unrendered ones already in the response, and additive-only API proposals marked non-breaking
assertions: Names at least one fintech benchmark (Stripe, Mercury, Ramp, or Wise) together with a specific borrowed mechanic, not just the product name
The generated prompt's content inventory preserves all four currently rendered data points (date, description, amount, status)
Identifies data already in the API response but not rendered today (currency, counterparty, payment_method, or has_more pagination)
The prompt block is self-contained — it does not reference file paths, the codebase, or other sections of the document a design tool cannot see
Proposes at least one additive API change with a method and path (or an optional field on the existing endpoint) plus a response shape, explicitly marked non-breaking
Does not propose removing, renaming, or changing the type of any existing field in GET /api/transactions

evals.expected_output: An audit noting the missing loading and empty states, Linear/Height benchmarks with named mechanics, a self-contained prompt that keeps the status filter and row navigation, and use of already-returned fields before proposing any new API
assertions: Names Linear or Height together with a specific borrowed mechanic (grouped lists with counts, keyboard navigation or command palette, inline editing, or optimistic updates) rather than only the product name
Preserves the existing status filter and its three options (all, open, closed) in the redesign
Flags that the component has no loading state and no empty state today, and specifies both in the generated prompt
Surfaces response data that is already returned but unrendered (priority, labels, updated_at, comment_count, or avatar_url) as usable without any new API
States explicitly that the redesign is presentation-only and preserves row-click navigation to /issues/:id
Any proposed API addition is additive-only and states what the design renders before it ships (graceful degradation)

evals.prompt:
Redesign brief needed for our deployments page. Give me something I can paste into Stitch. ```tsx export default function Deployments({ deployments }) { return (

Deployments

{deployments.map((d) => (
{d.id} {d.status} {d.branch} {d.created_at}
))}
) } ``` The page is server-rendered from `GET /api/deployments`: ```json { "deployments": [ { "id": "dpl_7Kq2", "status": "ready", "branch": "main", "commit_sha": "9f3c1ab", "commit_message": "fix: handle null region in edge config", "author": "bmulumia", "created_at": "2026-03-14T11:02:44Z", "duration_ms": 84200, "environment": "production", "url": "https://app-9f3c1ab.example.dev" } ] } ```
evals.expected_output: A status-first redesign prompt drawing on Vercel/Railway mechanics, using the six already-returned but unrendered fields instead of proposing new APIs for them, keeping the Rollback action as a guarded destructive action, and ending with a checkable invariants list
assertions: Names Vercel, Railway, Supabase, or Planetscale together with a specific borrowed mechanic (status-first rows, monospaced commit metadata, inline expandable logs, or typed confirmation on destructive actions)
Preserves the per-row Rollback action and treats it as a destructive action in the redesign
Uses the already-returned but unrendered fields (commit_sha, commit_message, author, duration_ms, environment, url) rather than proposing new APIs for data the response already contains
The generated prompt specifies loading, empty, and error states
Proposes at most three API additions, each marked non-breaking, or states that no API changes are required
Produces a behavioural invariants checklist with specific checkable items derived from the current page's interactions
